name: @projexlight/service-registry-mcp
summary: Hosted MCP service — Fastify daemon exposing the projex_registry_* tool surface over SSE so non-monorepo customers can discover + install SDKs from any MCP-aware AI client. Sibling of packages/registry-mcp-local (stdio variant). Adds JWT auth, per-tenant rate-limiting, audit→sdk-meter wiring, and on-disk catalog hot-reload so new SDK manifests propagate without restart.

endpoints.description: Health + catalog + reload counters + active session count.
Open SSE stream + start MCP session (Bearer JWT).

events.name: registry-mcp.session.opened.v1
events.description: SSE session opened; carries tenant + persona context.

events.name: registry-mcp.session.closed.v1
events.description: SSE session closed normally or by disconnect.

events.name: registry-mcp.catalog.reloaded.v1
events.description: On-disk catalog mtime advanced; in-memory Registry swapped atomically.

hooks.name: startServer
hooks.description: Boot Fastify; wire SSE + messages endpoints + healthz.

hooks.name: buildApp
hooks.description: Lower-level entry — build the Fastify app for tests / embedding.

hooks.name: createRegistryRef
hooks.description: Build a hot-reloadable Registry reference + watcher handle.

scenarios.title: Customer's Claude Code opens an SSE session
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer ran `projex init my-app --hosted-url https://registry.projexcloud.com/mcp/sse --api-token <jwt>`; Claude Code now opens the SSE stream on startup.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Server validates JWT, rate-limits tenant, opens SSE, returns session_id. Subsequent JSON-RPC messages flow through /mcp/messages with the session_id. Tools light up in Claude Code.

scenarios.title: Each CallTool invocation meters against the tenant
scenarios.when_to_use: Every tool call hits the audit sink — composed audit→stdout + audit→sdk-meter chain attributes the call to the JWT's tenant + emits UsageEvent.v1 under a registry.read.* SKU.
scenarios.expected_outcome: UsageEvent.v1 emitted with the right SKU + dimensions. meter-collector rolls up; sdk-billing renders the invoice.

scenarios.title: Operator drops a new catalog onto the volume → no restart
scenarios.when_to_use: ci/cd writes a fresh registry.catalog.json + registry.embeddings.bin into the service's mount; the watcher polls the mtime + atomically swaps the in-memory Registry.
scenarios.example_code:
// background watcher inside startCatalogWatcher.
// open SSE sessions pick up the new catalog on their next CallTool.
scenarios.expected_outcome: GET /healthz shows catalog_reload_count++. No client reconnect required. Failed reloads (corrupt file) keep serving the previous Registry.

scenarios.title: Rate limit protects against runaway agent
scenarios.when_to_use: Agent loops; rate-limiter denies past 120 calls/min per tenant.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Caller sees 429. Tenant-admin can adjust the limit if legitimate growth.

scenarios.title: Dev mode runs without JWT
scenarios.when_to_use: Local dev with REGISTRY_MCP_AUTH_MODE=disabled; returns anonymous context; useful for smoke tests.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Service accepts unauthenticated requests; audit logs anonymous-dev as the actor.

compliance_posture.notes: Every tool call audited + metered against the JWT-bound tenant — full attribution for any AI-agent decision routed through the catalog. JWT validated against sdk-identity's six-layer claim shape; rate-limit per tenant enforces fair use. Hot-reload's fail-closed behavior on corrupt catalog satisfies SOC2 change-management.
